visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A four-way split-screen montage displays a grilled hamburger patty on a wire rack, a young woman in a white sweater eating, a man in a denim jacket eating with an exaggerated expression, and a chef's hands in black gloves shaping a raw meat patty over a grill. (2) A man wearing a grey beanie and a denim jacket stands outside a modern glass building, gesturing with peace signs towards the camera with a bright smile. The outdoor setting shows green foliage and urban architectural elements. (3) The camera follows the man as he enters a dimly lit restaurant featuring a large circular counter. Chefs in black uniforms are visible working in the central open kitchen area. (4) Close-up shots focus on the grilling process where several hamburger patties are being cooked on a charcoal grill, with visible flames and smoke rising. A chef in black gloves meticulously flips the patties. (5) The man sits at the counter, lifting a large bite of a juicy hamburger patty towards his mouth with chopsticks. He is wearing a grey beanie and a denim shirt. (6) A hand pours a dark liquid sauce from a small glass bottle over a bowl containing white rice and a white creamy topping. (7) A person's hand with red-manicured nails cracks a raw egg, placing the bright yellow yolk perfectly on top of a hamburger patty sitting on a bed of rice. (8) A small white plate holds various condiments including green wasabi, red chili flakes, and fried garlic chips. The man uses chopsticks to pick up a piece of the meat coated in garlic. (9) The man and a woman appear together in a medium shot at the counter, laughing and talking while eating. (10) Final scenes show close-ups of the steaming white rice being scooped into a bowl, followed by a text overlay providing the restaurant's address and hours in front of the restaurant's entrance at dusk.
